# GrandCanonicalOptimization

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A statistical-mechanics framework for solving random optimization problems by allowing variable particle number (grand-canonical ensemble) rather than fixed constraints. Provides a new theoretical tool for designing topology-adaptive routing and resource allocation in dynamic interconnect networks.
